title: neo-toolkit: AFM Image Segmentation and Error-Correction Decoding for DNA-Origami Data Storage
description: AFM image segmentation (SAM2-based instance segmentation of DNA origami in AFM scans) and error-correction decoding (the (20,10) error-correcting code, channel simulation, detector model, and decoding) for the NEO DNA-origami data storage project. Developed as part of NEO (Next Generation Molecular Data Storage), Horizon Europe grant agreement No. 101115317.
